title: Final Project
text:
Background
The final project is the reproduction of figure 3, from the article by Douglas A. Schafer titled, “Effects of hurricane disturbance on stream water concentrations and fluxes in eight tropical forest watersheds of the Luquillo Experimental Forest, Puerto Rico”. The final output is a graph depicting a 9 week average from the years between 1985 to 1995, from four locations in Puerto Rico: Bisley Quebrada 1-3 (BQ1-3) and Puente Roto Mameyes. In the article, the results show that Nitrate, Ammonium, and Potassium have increased, while Magnesium and Calcium did not that hurricanes can have an effect on streamwater. The hurricane disturbance had a different effect on different chemicals. The most disturbed watersheds were at the sites BQ1-3.


Data
The data is from William H. McDowell at the International Institute of Tropical Forestry(IITF), USDA Forest Service, that was downloaded from the EDI Data Portal.

Methods
The first steps to reproducing the figure from Schaefer’s article was to sort through the raw data by cleaning it using select and filter functions. Sample_Date, Sample_ID, NH4-N, NO3-N, Ca, Mg, K and filtering through the correct time period which was from 1988 to the end of 1994.


Results
the v-line shown going down the graph represents the hurricane hugo formation.
